key_insight: Cognivia is an evidence-based CBT copilot that detects cognitive distortions and generates more rational, therapist-aligned responses for mental healthcare.
engineering_relevance: It shows how to adapt a lightweight LLM for a specialized clinical support task using curated domain data, structured prompting, and expert-supervised evaluation.
method: Builds an augmented CBT dataset from authoritative CBT texts plus mental health Q&A data.
Uses multi-stage prompting and structured generation to guide distortion identification and response writing.
Fine-tunes a lightweight LLM and introduces a hierarchical quality evaluation framework for rational responses.
evidence_signal: The system was tested with lexical metrics, LLM-based judges, and human evaluation by 10 behavioral science experts, where it consistently outperformed baselines.
watch_item: As a clinical-support model, it still requires careful expert oversight to avoid overconfident or inappropriate advice in sensitive mental health settings.
paper_title: Cognivia: A Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Copilot for Evidence-Based Mental Healthcare
